description: A Global Drought and Flood Catalogue from 1950 to 2016 is an open dataset on Amazon S3 listed in Registry of Open Data on AWS (urban, water, hazard and energy tags), a registry of open datasets hosted on Amazon S3 under the section "floods", published or maintained by PREP-NexT Lab. Hydrological extremes, in the form of droughts and floods, have impacts on a wide range of sectors including water availability, food security, and energy production, among others. Coverage: as stated on the registry page. The registry lists it under the tag floods and hosts it on Amazon S3. Update frequency: No future updates planned. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY-SA 4.0 (as given on the registry page). Caveats: this record was written from the registry page, which was read; the data on S3 were not opened, the licence text was shortened, and the description may lag the source. It can support data-driven infrastructure planning and analysis. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-registry-of-open-data-on-aws-urban-water-hazard-tags.
